## Change summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Release assurance

- [ ] Build passes locally/CI.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included in code, logs or fixtures.
- [ ] Authentication/authorization impact reviewed.
- [ ] Tenant-isolation impact reviewed.
- [ ] Database changes are captured in a migration.
- [ ] Rollback path is understood.
- [ ] New or changed API routes have smoke/security coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] Driver/mobile/PWA behaviour reviewed if affected.
- [ ] Offline/retry/idempotency behaviour reviewed if affected.
- [ ] User-visible claims remain truthful and do not imply unearned regulatory certification.

## Verification evidence

Add the relevant workflow run, test output or manual verification notes.
